Assessment of BA.evidence_source: The factor structure of the BAS-2 was examined using a principal-axis exploratory factor analysis (EFA) with quartimax rotation (because of the expectation of a single factor; see Swami & Ng, 2015; Tylka & Wood-Barcalow, 2015b).

Correlation between body appreciation an.evidence_source: Pearson correlation coefficients were used to investigate associations between body appreciation, self-esteem, life satisfaction, BMI, and age. (No specific correlation value was provided in this section.)

Number of studies.evidence_source: The section describes statistical analyses for a single study, referring to 'the BAS-2' and 'the EFA' in a singular context.

section_summary.extract_value: This section details the statistical methods employed, including a principal-axis exploratory factor analysis (EFA) with quartimax rotation to examine the factor structure of the BAS-2, conducted separately for women and men. It also describes the use of independent t-tests to compare BAS-2 items and total scores between genders, and Pearson correlation coefficients to investigate associations between body appreciation, self-esteem, life satisfaction, BMI, and age for a single study.
